name: pyne
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, autocomplete, hover, and formatting for .pyne / .pine sources. Powered by hoox-pyne. Part of the HOOX open trading stack. Unofficial — not affiliated with TradingView, Inc.

pynescript.lsp.enabled.description: Enable the PYNE language server (completion, hover, diagnostics, symbols).

pynescript.lsp.command.description: LSP launch command. Use "auto" to try pyne-lsp (then pynescript-lsp) on PATH, then python -m pynescript.langserver. Or set an absolute path, or "docker" with lsp.args for ghcr.io/hoox-sh/pyne/lsp. ${workspaceFolder} is expanded.

pynescript.lsp.python.description: Python interpreter used when lsp.command is auto and neither pyne-lsp nor pynescript-lsp is on PATH (must have: pip install "hoox-pyne[lsp]").

pynescript.lsp.args.description: Extra arguments passed to the language server process.

enumDescriptions: PYNE Void — indigo accent, near-black surfaces (default).
PYNE Volt — lime accent, neutral surfaces.
pynescript.theme.description: PYNE product theme. Applies the matching color theme (syntax highlighting + hover cards) when pynescript.theme.applyWorkbench is on.

pynescript.theme.applyWorkbench.description: Switch the VS Code workbench theme to the selected PYNE theme (PYNE Void / PYNE Volt / PYNE Orange).

pynescript.install.autoInstall.description: When the language server is missing, install it automatically with pip (no prompt). Requires a Python 3.10+ interpreter with pip.

pynescript.install.autoPrompt.description: When the language server is missing and autoInstall is off, show a one-time prompt offering to install it with pip.

pynescript.install.package.description: pip requirement spec installed by “PYNE: Install Language Server” (default: hoox-pyne[lsp]).

pynescript.install.python.description: Python interpreter used for pip install (and as an LSP module-launch candidate). Empty = fall back to pynescript.lsp.python, then python3 / python / py.

pynescript.install.args.description: Extra arguments passed to pip install (e.g. ["--no-cache-dir"]).

pynescript.install.createVenv.description: When the resolved Python is externally managed (PEP 668), create an isolated virtualenv under the extension storage and install there.

pynescript.install.venv.description: Explicit virtualenv directory to create/use for the language server. Empty = auto (extension storage) when needed.

pynescript.formatting.enabled.description: Enable formatting support (when the server supports it).

pynescript.diagnostics.enabled.description: Enable diagnostic squiggles from the language server.

pynescript.diagnostics.severity.description: Override diagnostic severity by lint code prefix, e.g. {"W": "Hint"} demotes W001-style warnings to hints. Keys are code prefixes; values are Error / Warning / Information / Hint.

pynescript.completion.snippets.description: Enable snippet completions for builtin functions.

pynescript.hover.enabled.description: Show hover information for identifiers, builtins, and types.

pynescript.signatureHelp.enabled.description: Show function signature help when typing call arguments.

pynescript.semanticTokens.enabled.description: Colorize tokens by language type (namespace, function, variable, keyword, …) via the language server.

pynescript.documentHighlight.enabled.description: Highlight all occurrences of the identifier under the cursor.

pynescript.linkedEditing.enabled.description: Enable linked editing (rename-as-you-type) for the same identifier in one document. Also requires the editor's linkedEditing setting.

pynescript.selectionRange.enabled.description: Enable smart selection (expand/shrink selection around the cursor).

pynescript.documentLink.enabled.description: Detect http(s) links in comments and string literals and make them clickable.

pynescript.codeAction.enabled.description: Offer code actions such as Convert to Pine v6 and the W001 QuickFix.

pynescript.formatOnSave.enabled.description: Format the document on save using the language server (requires pynescript.formatting.enabled).

pynescript.pro.enabled.description: Enable PYNE Pro integration (Run on Pro). Requires pynescript.pro.apiKey and a backend URL (pynescript.backend.url or the hosted backend).

pynescript.pro.apiKey.description: Pro API key (minted via POST /auth/create_key on your Pro instance). Stored in VS Code settings only.

pynescript.backend.url.description: PYNE backend base URL (no trailing /run), e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5002 or a self-hosted Pro API.

pynescript.backend.useHosted.description: Use the hosted pynescript.online backend with PYNE Pro instead of pynescript.backend.url.

pynescript.backend.hostedUrl.description: Hosted backend base URL used when pynescript.backend.useHosted is on.

pynescript.backend.package.description: pip requirement spec installed by “PYNE: Install Backend (Pro API)” (default: hoox-pyne[pro,lsp]).

pynescript.backend.path.description: Path to a PYNE checkout containing backend/app.py, used by “PYNE: Start Backend”. Empty = first workspace folder.
